data.description: Mode of structure block; `0` means load, `1` data (consumed by pools), `2` save.

dataField.description: Metadata to be passed when  is set to data mode.

ignoreEntities.description: Load or save NBT data of entities contained in bounds, existing data will be omitted.

includePlayers.description: Load or save NBT data of players contained in bounds.

integrity.description: Lower values destructs more random selected blocks.

mirror.description: `0` means no mirroring, `1` mirror above x, `2` mirror above y, `3` mirror above z

redstoneSaveMode.description: `0` means save signal power (lit lamps, redstone itself, etc.), `1` forget (unlit sources will be updated when structure is placed).

removeBlocks.description: Blocks will be merged (with structure air as real air) or pasted as-is.

rotation.description: `0` means no rotation, `1` 90 degress, `2` 180 degress, `3` 270 degress.

seed.description: Seed to be passed when configuring

showBoundingBox.description: Display bounds of structure in-world, includes vertex frame above.

structureName.description: Vanilla or behavior pack namespaced (first directory determines namespace, subfolders joined with `.`) relative path to structure, try something like `"minecraft:endcity.ship"`.
